opening.argument: The interview grounds its discussion in specific business operations: Carlsberg uses AI to study how yeast and other components behave over time, instruments bars to gather operational data, and migrates infrastructure to Azure Cloud. These concrete examples support the speakers' broader account of digital technology as a way to change how the company operates. The presentation is informational and promotional business commentary, not an offer of financial returns or a request for sensitive information. Although it includes links and a subscription request, neither is connected to payment, investment, credential collection, or deceptive participation.
